title: Do They Love the Sea as We Do?

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: Sitting on the beach at sunset, a villager wonders whether people on distant shores love the sea as much as Isolans.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Sitting on the beach at sunset, (name1) wonders whether people on distant shores love the sea as much as Isolans.

choices.label: Ask What the Sea Means Here.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The villager imagines someone far away watching the same waves and feeling the same peace.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A fisher says loving the sea and fearing it can go together, anywhere.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A scholar suggests that people who rely on the sea might see it as work, not beauty.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A fisher admits that on some mornings they feel that way too.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The village shares stories of the sea, some happy and some sad.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A villager who dislikes the sea says so, and everyone respects it.

text_only.reason: a feeling in the moment, not a lasting dislike -- story only: the file marks no effect (no new mechanics)
